## Activity

During June 2023, River Outreach recorded 48 captures. This reflects the capture activity reported for the site during the month. The activity level should continue to be monitored through routine operational review, with any recurring issues recorded promptly so that they can be followed up through the appropriate service arrangements.

## Image quality

Of the captures completed, 4 were assessed as ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.3. This result should be considered alongside the operational experience at the site, particularly where equipment or image acquisition issues may affect the quality of submissions. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk to support review and follow-up.

## Grading

Grading identified 5 results as referable. The median grading wait was 0. This indicates that the reported grading activity was completed without a median delay during the period covered by this report. The site should continue to record capture, image quality and grading issues through normal operational processes, ensuring that any recurring camera concerns remain visible to the service desk and relevant teams.
